g.text: BankDash Dashboard Eye-Catching Animation Visual Locations
Visual mapping of all 7 key interactive animations & visual effects
3D Parallax Tilt + Dynamic Light Glare
Card tilts 3D with cursor movement + dynamic radial glare reflection
TRIGGER: Mouse move over cards | Also: Rolling Balance Count-up
Row Hover Glide + Amount Count-Up
Smooth 6px slide on hover, icon scale & dynamic numerical tickers
TRIGGER: Mouse hover on rows / Initial page view
Elastic Bar Spring-Up + Interactive Glow
Bars spring up sequentially with stagger; glow & tooltip on hover
TRIGGER: Dashboard load / Tab switch / Bar hover
Donut Segment Hover Scale + Tooltips
Slices pop outward (scale 1.04) with deep drop-shadow & highlight
TRIGGER: Hovering individual chart slices
Confetti Burst + Plane Flight + Pulse
18-particle confetti explosion, paper-plane flight launch,
payee avatar pulse ring & live balance count-down
TRIGGER: Clicking the Send button
Live Pulsating Sonar Radar Beacon
Concentric beacon ring expands and fades on the active "Jan" point;
gradient spline area shimmer + hover coordinate highlight
TRIGGER: Constant ambient live pulse on Jan peak
Header: Bell Jiggle, Gear Spin, Search Glow
Bell swings playfully, settings gear rotates 60°, search expands glow
TRIGGER: Hover bell/gear, focus search input
KEY INTERACTIONS SUMMARY:
Cards: 3D Tilt
Transactions: Glide
Weekly: Elastic Spring
Expense: Donut Pop
Transfer: Confetti
Balance: Radar Beacon
Header: Jiggle
All interactions use GPU hardware-accelerated transforms & zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0.00) with accessible aria controls.
